topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Workforce use rules in POL-02 Part C; sanctions rule in POL-02 A.4
gap: No signed acknowledgments yet
remediation: Collect signed acknowledgments from all 7 employees (POL-02 C.7)

control_description: Single-owner LLC with no board. The Owner and General Manager reviews POA&M progress monthly with the Office Manager from 2026-09. Compensating check: the independent assessor reviews the risk register and POA&M each year (P01 section 1)
gap: Oversight just started; no record yet. The person overseeing security also accepts risk and dispatches trains
remediation: Keep monthly review notes; annual independent review

control_description: Office Manager designated Security Lead in writing (POL-02); General Manager primary and Roadmaster alternate TSA Security Coordinators, reported to TSA (49 CFR 1570.201); MSP duties in the MSP contract
evidence: POL-02; Security Coordinator letter to TSA; MSP contract

control_description: Hazmat security awareness and in-depth security training current for the 4 hazmat employees (49 CFR 172.704); certified locomotive engineer and conductor; MSP technicians for technical work
gap: No cyber or phishing training for anyone
remediation: Annual security awareness training and quarterly phishing simulations (POAM-007)

control_description: Sanctions rule in POL-02 A.4; an owner and due date for every P01 treatment and every POA&M item
evidence: POL-02; P01 risk register; P07 POA&M
gap: Not yet applied; no sanction records
remediation: Record sanctions when applied; monthly POA&M review

control_description: None beyond the MSP's list of the 5 computers: no inventory of tablets, network devices, radio equipment, telematics units, SaaS accounts, or Restricted information locations
gap: No inventory
remediation: One-page inventory of devices, radio and telematics components, SaaS accounts, and Restricted information locations (POL-04 4.5)

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies approved 2026-08-31 and stored in the shared drive; incident reporting card at the desk and in each cab
gap: Policies not yet walked through with staff; cards not yet posted
remediation: Staff briefing and cards (POAM-006); acknowledgments

control_description: Security Coordinators reported to TSA; interchange contacts with the Class I; vendor contacts in the incident binder
evidence: TSA designation letter; incident binder contact card
gap: No named security contact given to the Class I or customers; the Class I questionnaire is not yet answered
remediation: Send this summary, the checklist, and the POA&M to the Class I; name the Office Manager as security contact

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Risk tolerance and acceptance authority defined; safety risks at High never accepted
2026 risk assessment with NIST SP 800-30 Rev. 1 (22 risks) and BIA (8 processes)
Business email compromise and payment redirection assessed (P01 R-009, after the 2025 event); rule to confirm any bank detail change by phone (POL-02 C.6)
gap: Other fraud scenarios not assessed (for example altered demurrage or car hire records, or misuse of the operations system to change waybills)
remediation: Add billing and waybill fraud scenarios to the July 2027 risk assessment

control_description: Risk assessment updated after major changes (POL-02 A.2); check of TSA, hazmat security, and PTC duties before new customers, commodities, or movements (POL-02 A.10); new-vendor approval (POL-04 4.6)
gap: Rules approved 2026-08-31 but not yet used; no record of a change review
remediation: Record a change review for the AI pilot contract and the dispatch desktop replacement

control_description: Independent control assessment 2026-08-04 to 2026-08-06 (12 controls, 84 determination statements); annual assessment required by POL-02 A.6
Deficiencies tracked in the POA&M (12 items) and reviewed monthly with the Owner and General Manager

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected in the SSP from the Moderate baseline, tailored for a 7-person railroad
gap: 6 of 42 SSP controls are still planned and 25 are partially implemented
remediation: Complete the POA&M and the remaining planned controls

control_description: MSP runs patching, antivirus, firewall, Wi-Fi, and backup under contract
evidence: MSP contract; monthly MSP patch report
gap: No oversight of MSP work; the dispatch desktop was excluded from upgrades without company approval
remediation: Monthly MSP report review; written approval for any exclusion (POAM-011); annual MSP review (POAM-009)

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Three policies approved (POL-02, POL-03, POL-04); POL-01 and POL-05 are pointers
gap: Procedures not yet written: contingency plan and paper dispatch procedure, onboarding and termination checklist, restore test record
remediation: Write the procedures (POAM-001, POAM-004)

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: MFA on all suite accounts and the 2 SYS-01 administrator accounts; SYS-01 roles limit who can issue authorities; SaaS encryption at rest
evidence: Suite and SYS-01 MFA settings; SYS-01 role list
gap: Crew tablets share one SYS-01 login without MFA; backup console, firewall, and telematics portal accept a password alone
remediation: MFA on MSP-held and telematics logins (POAM-002); named crew accounts with MFA (POAM-001)

control_description: Office Manager creates SYS-01 accounts; the MSP creates suite and device accounts on request
gap: No approval record; no onboarding checklist; account types not documented
remediation: Onboarding checklist and account types (POAM-001)

control_description: SYS-01 role-based access (only the dispatcher role issues authorities)
evidence: SYS-01 role list; P07 AC-2 and AC-3 results
gap: Shared crew password unchanged for 5 months after the Conductor left; SSI open to every account, including the MSP's; no access reviews
remediation: Termination checklist and monthly reconciliation (POAM-001); restricted SSI folder (POAM-012)

control_description: Office and enginehouse locked with an alarm after hours; limited key holders; vendor data centers covered by vendor SOC 2 reports
evidence: Key list; operations SaaS vendor SOC 2

control_description: Disposal rule in POL-04 4.9 (wipe before reuse or certified destruction)
gap: Rule approved 2026-08-31; no disposal records yet
remediation: Disposal record for every device, starting with the replaced dispatch desktop

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: MSP-managed firewall blocks unsolicited inbound traffic and exposes no services; MFA on SaaS email
evidence: Firewall rule export; P07 SC-7 results
gap: Flat network lets office computers reach the dispatch desktop; the MSP's remote tool reaches every computer with no evidence of MFA
remediation: Dispatch segment (POAM-010); MSP technician list and MFA evidence (POAM-009)

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS for all SaaS traffic, including interchange EDI handled by SYS-01
gap: No automatic encryption for outside email that carries Restricted information (POL-04 4.3)
remediation: Suite rule that encrypts outside email carrying Restricted information

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: MSP-managed antivirus on all 5 computers with automatic updates
evidence: Antivirus console export; P07 SI-3 test
gap: Alerts reach the MSP only in business hours; no behavior-based detection; the radio console software was quarantined once in 2026-04
remediation: MSP-managed EDR with alert monitoring and an allow list for the console software (POAM-005)

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: MSP patches computers monthly and firewall firmware quarterly
gap: No vulnerability scanning; the dispatch desktop runs an operating system version past end of vendor support
remediation: Quarterly scans (P02 RA-5); replace the dispatch desktop (POAM-011)

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: None beyond antivirus alerts
gap: No log review or monitoring
remediation: Monthly sign-in review (POAM-008); EDR alert monitoring (POAM-005)

control_description: Incident log and TSA reporting test required by POL-03 4.4 and 4.9
gap: The 2025 mailbox compromise was not evaluated as a TSA-reportable cyber attack; no incident records before 2026-08
remediation: Start the incident log; TSA report form with cyber fields; ask TSA how to handle the 2025 event (POAM-006)

control_description: Ransomware runbook with the paper dispatch switch, the TSA report step, and the MSP and insurer in the notification chain
gap: Not tested
remediation: Tabletop with the MSP (POAM-004)

control_description: Operations SaaS vendor recovery (RTO 4 h, RPO 1 h); nightly suite backup; paper dispatch as a habit
evidence: Operations SaaS vendor SOC 2; SYS-05 job report
gap: Suite restore never tested; no company-held copy of operations data; no written contingency plan; paper dispatch never drilled
remediation: Restore tests and weekly operations data export (POAM-003, POAM-004); contingency plan and paper dispatch drill

control_description: None: the MSP changes devices without the company's approval
gap: No change approval; the upgrade exclusion on the dispatch desktop was never approved
remediation: MSP change notice and company approval for exclusions and any change to the dispatch desktop (MSP contract amendment, POAM-009)

control_description: BIA completed; cyber liability insurance with a breach hotline; paper track warrant forms and a printed timetable at the desk
gap: No written contingency plan; one internet line with no failover
remediation: Contingency plan (POAM-004); cellular failover router

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Operations SaaS vendor SOC 2 Type 2 report reviewed 2026-08-19 (Part B)
gap: No security terms in the MSP contract; AI pilot vendor terms not reviewed; payroll vendor not reviewed
remediation: MSP amendment, AI pilot terms, and payroll vendor report (POAM-009)

control_description: Capacity of SaaS services managed by the vendors; one business internet line
evidence: Operations SaaS vendor SOC 2 (availability); internet contract
gap: Single internet line with no failover; the General Manager's phone hotspot is the only fallback
remediation: Cellular failover router

control_description: Operations SaaS vendor replication and backups (RTO 4 h, RPO 1 h, meeting the BIA for BP-01); suite copied nightly with 30 days of versions
evidence: Operations SaaS vendor SOC 2; SYS-05 job report
gap: Suite backup not immutable and its console has no MFA; the company holds no copy of its operations data
remediation: 90-day immutable versions and weekly export of car inventory and authority history (POAM-003); MFA on the backup console (POAM-002)

control_description: None
gap: No restore test; no paper dispatch drill
remediation: Quarterly restore tests; paper dispatch drill twice a year; annual tabletop (POAM-004)
